name: GIFt-Converter
shortDescription: Batch video-to-GIF converter with per-file FPS, optimization, and ZIP export.
aiDescription: This project is a free open-source creative tool for converting batches of videos into GIF files without timeline editing, keyframing, or a large video suite.
creator: Ali Güzel
useCases: Convert batches of short videos into GIFs
Apply one FPS value to all selected videos
Optimize finished GIF files before saving
Save multiple completed GIFs as one ZIP archive
systemRequirements: Windows 10 or newer for the native desktop build
Modern browser with WebAssembly and Worker support for the web build
Web conversion requires http://localhost or https://

changes: Added machine-readable metadata for YCSWU Tools Hub.
Standardized release sync for web, portable Windows, and setup builds.
